title: The Bridge That Fell for a Song

lines.tts: Seventy-four soldiers knocked down an iron bridge just by walking across it.
lines.text: Seventy-four soldiers knocked down an iron bridge just by walking across it.

lines.tts: It's 1831, and the brand new bridge over the river is the pride of the whole town.
lines.text: It's 1831, and the brand new bridge over the river is the pride of the whole town.

lines.tts: The men are marching home four across, every boot hitting the planks at the exact same moment.
lines.text: The men are marching home four across, every boot hitting the planks at the exact same moment.

lines.tts: Halfway over, the bridge starts bouncing under their feet.
lines.text: Halfway over, the bridge starts bouncing under their feet.

lines.tts: A normal person would slow down, but these guys think it's hilarious.
lines.text: A normal person would slow down, but these guys think it's hilarious.

lines.tts: Somebody starts whistling a marching tune, and the whole column stomps along to it, a little harder every step.
lines.text: Somebody starts whistling a marching tune, and the whole column stomps along to it, a little harder every step.

lines.tts: The bounce gets bigger, the chains start groaning, and nobody wants to be the one who breaks step.
lines.text: The bounce gets bigger, the chains start groaning, and nobody wants to be the one who breaks step.

lines.tts: Then a single bolt snaps, and the whole end of the bridge drops into the river.
lines.text: Then a single bolt snaps, and the whole end of the bridge drops into the river.

lines.tts: Luckily, the river was only two feet deep.
lines.text: Luckily, the river was only two feet deep.

lines.tts: Unluckily, the river was only two feet deep.
lines.text: Unluckily, the river was only two feet deep.

lines.tts: You see, every bridge has a rhythm it naturally likes to sway at.
lines.text: You see, every bridge has a rhythm it naturally likes to sway at.

lines.tts: Ever pushed a kid on a swing? Each push is tiny, but if they all land at just the right moment, the swing goes higher and higher.
lines.text: Ever pushed a kid on a swing? Each push is tiny, but if they all land at just the right moment, the swing goes higher and higher.

lines.tts: Seventy-four men stepping together were pushing that bridge like a swing.
lines.text: Seventy-four men stepping together were pushing that bridge like a swing.

lines.tts: Nobody died, but the army made a rule: never cross a bridge in step.
lines.text: Nobody died, but the army made a rule: never cross a bridge in step.

lines.tts: So now, the best drilled soldiers in the world cross every bridge like a crowd of tourists.
